title: NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit Protocol for Illumina
author: New England Biolabs
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.t8xerxn
materials: NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit
Proceed directly to Second Strand cDNA Synthesis.

[ ! ] Dilute the red NEBNext Adaptor* prior to setting up the ligation reaction in ice-cold Adaptor Dilution Buffer and keep the adaptor on ice. Total RNA Input Dilution Required 1,000 ng–101 ng 5–fold dilution in Adaptor Dilution Buffer 100 ng–10 ng 25–fold dilution in Adaptor Dilution Buffer 5 ng 200–fold dilution in Adaptor Dilution Buffer *The NEBNext adaptor is provided in NEBNext oligos kit. NEB has several oligo kit options, which are supplied separately from the library prep kit.
Proceed immediately to Purification of the Ligation Reaction.

[ ! ] Incubate the sample in a preheated thermocycler with the heated lid set at ≥ 80 °C as follows: Note: If you are following recommendations in Appendix A (Chapter 6), for libraries with longer inserts (> 200 bases), increase the incubation at 42°C from 15 minutes to 50 minutes at Step 2 below. Step 1: 00:10:00 at 25 °C Step 2: 00:15:00 at 42 °C Step 3: 00:15:00 at 70 °C Step 4: Hold at 4 °C

steps.title: Fragment RNA
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample in a thermocycler at 94 °C. Use fragmentation times based on RIN value for fragments ~200 nt (refer to Table 1) or Appendix A (Chapter 6) for intact RNA with large inserts (> 200 bp).

substeps.instruction: Immediately transfer the tube to ice after incubation.

steps.title: Assemble Fragmentation and Priming Mix
steps.instruction: Assemble the fragmentation and priming reaction on ice in a nuclease-free tube (required only for intact or partially degraded RNA).

substeps.instruction: Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down 10 times.

steps.title: First Strand cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Assemble the first strand synthesis reaction on ice by adding the following components to the fragmented and primed RNA: 10 µl Fragmented and Primed RNA, 8 µl NEBNext Strand Specificity Reagent (#E7766), and 2 µl NEBNext First Strand Synthesis Enzyme Mix (#E7761) for a total volume of 20 µl.

substeps.instruction: Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down 10 times.

steps.title: Second Strand cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Assemble the second strand cDNA synthesis reaction on ice by adding the following components to the first strand synthesis product: 20 µl First Strand Synthesis Product, 8 µl NEBNext Second Strand Synthesis Reaction Buffer with dUTP (10X) (#E7426), 4 µl NEBNext Second Strand Synthesis Enzyme Mix (#E7425), and 48 µl Nuclease-free Water (#E7764) for a total volume of 80 µl.

substeps.instruction: Keeping the tube on ice, mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down at least 10 times.
Incubate in a thermocycler for 01:00:00 at 16 °C with the heated lid set at ≤ 40 °C (or off).

steps.title: Purify Second Strand Synthesis Product
steps.instruction: Clean up the second strand synthesis reaction using magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex NEBNext Sample Purification Beads (#E7767) to resuspend.
Add 144 µL (1.8X) of resuspended beads to the ~80 µL reaction; mix well via vortex or pipetting (10x).
Incubate for 00:05:00 at room temperature.
Briefly spin in a microcentrifuge, place on a magnet, and discard the supernatant once clear.
Add 200 µL freshly prepared 80% ethanol while in the magnetic rack, incubate at room temperature for 00:00:30, and discard the supernatant.
Repeat the ethanol wash once more (total of 2 washes).
Air-dry beads on the magnetic rack for up to 5 minutes (do not over-dry; beads should remain dark brown and glossy).
Remove tube from rack and elute DNA by adding 53 µL 0.1X TE Buffer (#E7763). Mix well (vortex or 10x pipetting).
Quickly spin and incubate for 00:02:00 at room temperature.
Place on magnetic rack until clear and transfer 50 µL of the supernatant to a clean nuclease-free PCR tube (store at –20°C if needed).

steps.title: End Prep Reaction
steps.instruction: Assemble the end prep reaction on ice by adding the following to the 50 µl second strand synthesis product: 7 µl NEBNext Ultra II End Prep Reaction Buffer (#E7647) and 3 µl NEBNext Ultra II End Prep Enzyme Mix (#E7646) for a total volume of 60 µl.

substeps.instruction: Mix by pipetting the entire volume up and down at least 10 times using a 100 μl or 200 μl pipette set to 50 μl.
Perform a quick spin to collect liquid.
Incubate in a thermocycler (heated lid ≥ 75 °C) as follows: 00:30:00 at 20 °C, then 00:30:00 at 65 °C, then hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Adaptor Ligation
steps.instruction: Assemble the ligation reaction on ice by adding the following to the 60 µl end prepped DNA: 2.5 µl Diluted Adaptor, 1 µl NEBNext Ligation Enhancer (#E7374), and 30 µl NEBNext Ultra II Ligation Master Mix (#E7648) for a total volume of 93.5 µl.

substeps.instruction: Mix thoroughly by pipetting the entire volume up and down at least 10 times using a 100 μl or 200 μl pipette set to 80 μl.
Perform a quick spin to collect liquid.
Incubate for 00:15:00 at 20 °C in a thermocycler.

steps.title: USER Enzyme Treatment
steps.instruction: Add 3 µL NEBNext USER Enzyme (#E7458) to the ligation mixture (total volume 96.5 µL).

substeps.instruction: Mix well and incubate at 37 °C for 00:15:00 with the heated lid set to ≥ 45 °C.

steps.title: Purify Ligated DNA
steps.instruction: Clean up the ligation product using magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 87 µL (0.9X) resuspended NEBNext Sample Purification Beads (#E7767) and mix well (vortex or 10x pipetting).
Incubate for 00:10:00 at room temperature.
Quickly spin and place on a magnetic rack; discard supernatant after ~00:05:00.
Add 200 µL freshly prepared 80% ethanol while in the rack, incubate at room temperature for 00:00:30, and discard supernatant.
Repeat the ethanol wash once more (total of 2 washes).
Briefly spin and return to the magnetic rack.
Remove residual ethanol and air-dry beads for up to 5 minutes (do not over-dry).
Remove tube from rack and elute DNA by adding 17 µL 0.1X TE. Mix well, quickly spin, and incubate for 00:02:00 at room temperature.
Place in magnet until clear and transfer 15 µL of the supernatant to a clean PCR tube (store at –20°C if needed).

steps.title: PCR Enrichment
steps.instruction: Verify oligo concentration is 10 μM. Set up the PCR reaction based on the oligo kit type:

substeps.instruction: Option A (Separate Primers): 14 µl Adaptor Ligated DNA, 25 µl NEBNext Ultra II Q5 Master Mix, 5 µl Universal PCR Primer/i5 Primer, 5 µl Index (X) Primer/i7 Primer (Total 50 µl).
Option B (Combined Primers): 15 µl Adaptor Ligated DNA, 25 µl NEBNext Ultra II Q5 Master Mix, 10 µl Index (X)/Universal Primer Mix (Total 50 µl).
Mix by gently pipetting up and down 10 times and quickly spin.

Perform PCR in a thermocycler (heated lid 105 °C): 1x 98°C for 30s; 7–16x (98°C for 10s, 65°C for 75s); 1x 65°C for 5 min; hold at 4°C. (Adjust cycles based on RNA input: 1,000 ng = 7–8 cycles; 100 ng = 11–12 cycles; 10 ng = 14–15 cycles).

steps.title: Final Library Purification
steps.instruction: Clean up the PCR reaction using magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex NEBNext Sample Purification Beads (#E6315) to resuspend.
Add 45 µL (0.9X) of resuspended beads to the ~50 µL PCR reaction; mix well (vortex or 10x pipetting).
Incubate for 00:05:00 at room temperature.
Quickly spin and place on a magnetic rack; discard supernatant after ~00:05:00.
Add 200 µL freshly prepared 80% ethanol while in the rack, incubate at room temperature for 00:00:30, and discard supernatant.
Repeat the ethanol wash once more (total of 2 washes).
Air-dry beads on the magnetic rack for up to 5 minutes (do not over-dry).
Remove tube from rack and elute DNA by adding 23 µL 0.1X TE. Mix well (10x pipetting), quickly spin, and incubate for 00:02:00 at room temperature.
Place in magnetic rack until clear and transfer 20 µL of the supernatant to a clean PCR tube; store at –20°C.

steps.title: Library Quality Control
steps.instruction: Analyze the library using a Bioanalyzer.

substeps.instruction: Run 1 µL library on a DNA 1000 chip (or High Sensitivity chip if yield is low).
Verify the electropherogram shows a narrow distribution with a peak size of approximately 300 bp.
If peaks at ~80 bp or 128 bp are visible, increase sample volume to 50 μl with 0.1X TE and repeat the SPRIselect/NEBNext bead cleanup.
